BiblicalUsage: A gift is what the king has not given, and the men of Judah say so when the men of Israel quarrel over bringing the king back. Have we eaten at all of the king's cost, they ask, or has he given us any gift? The word is the present that was never offered.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the question is the defence: Judah followed the king for kinship, not for gifts, and no present bought their loyalty.
